notes.title: Update to v1.8.5 - Unreal Engine 5
notes.content:
Update Notes

This update is porting United Assault - Normandy '44 to Unreal Engine 5, is adding Ray Tracing support and does improve on various aspects of the game.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40088640/fb8cf3b6aa2db4378996c060cce862b06a2e3120.png

 added Ray Tacing support
 added new dynamic performance tracker

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40088640/7666bc8e317950f2a7af0483b13e1f4a296fc88f.png

 fixed various issues
 fixed gamepad menu issues

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40088640/1e5028f1e91364a0961f3503b9cda075d0b281e2.png

 updated to Unreal Engine 5.1
 updated DLSS version
 updated vehicles to use Chaos Physics Engine
 updated weapon pickups
 updated game files for future updates


Important Informations
We started an update progress to Unreal Engine 5 a while ago and abandoned it because of the sheer number of bugs and issues the upgrade brought with it. This time it took us roughly a month to get the game fully working on UE5 with a lot of bugs fixed early on. However there is a potential this update brought with it new until unnoticed bugs we did not catch. Please report all bugs so we are able to fix them!

The game was not designed around Ray Tracing, which means especially interiours can be to dark at certain weather conditions. We are aware of this and want to correct this with future updates!

Savegames and Progression
The update to Unreal Engine 5 forced us to rework savegame compatibility. This means with this update Settings and Progressions are reset. There is a way to recover your old progression but this might cause game crashes.

Recovering Progress at your own risk:

 Open the folder C:\Users\DUsername\AppData\Local\UnitedAssault\Saved\SaveGames
 Create a subfolder called Normandy if it does not already exist
 Copy the file Normandy_Progression.sav into the new Normandy Subfolder


Playing the legacyUnreal Engine 4 game (v1.1.0)
The old Unreal Engine 4 version of the game is available legacy branch.

Check out United Assault - Battle of the Bulge!

notes.title: The future of United Assault
notes.content:
It is again time to look into the future of United Assault. Here is what you can expect in the coming weeks and months!

United Assault - Next
The next and final installment of the United Assault Trilogy is currently in development. We won't sahre any details on this project yet. We just want you to know a new Title is in development and will introduce new features which will again be patched intho Normandy '44 and Battle of the Bulge.

United Assault - Battle of the Bulge
We have collected a lot of feedback on Battle of the Bulge and decided we are going a different route then with Normandy '44! There will be no map expansion and rather a map enhancement. We will add more details, locations and improvements into the existing map. Besides this Battle of the Bluge will recieve Feature and Weapon updates from United Assault - Next.

The Playstation 4, Xbox One and Xbox Series versions are in certification and will release this year!

United Assault - Normandy '44
Normandy '44 will continue to recieve bug fix updates and after the launch of United Assault - Next, it will get some new weapon unlocks.

Unreal Engine 5
We have spent a lot of time in the past weeks to check the possibilities of a Unreal Engine 5 update. The game is partly working on the new engine but we decided to cancel this effort. The switch to UE5 would mean larger reworks which would end the compatibility to already released Console versions. Meaning there would never be any update to those versions ever again. And this is a step we won't take.

We’d love to keep you up-to-date! Please join us also on Discord or on Facebook

notes.title: Update to v1.7.5
notes.content:
This is a minor update targeting performance issues on lower end systems. 

United Assault - Normandy '44 now tracks the performance on your system and if it will ever run below 25 FPS it will track down the source and tries to free up some resources on runtime. If the framedrop happens to be CPU related, the game will temporarly disable several AI features (Hearing, Cover generator) until the game runs again at at least 30 FPS. If the performance drop is GPU related, impact particles, muzzle flashes and other minor visual features will be temporarly disabled until the game runs at at least 30 FPS again. 

This will not have any impact if you are running the game with higher framerates and is intended to improve the playability on low end systems.

We also increased the max Rank to 40 and overhauled the vehicle physics.

United Assault - Battle of the Bulge is releasing 07th April 2022 in Steam Early Access!

Gameplay Teaser
[previewyoutube=w6X1CWOJDS0;full][/previewyoutube]

United Assault - Battle of the Bulge is a standalone addon to United Assault - Normandy '44 and is build up on it's foundation.

New weapons, parts of the gameworld and drivable vehicles will be added over the time of early access.

The procedural generated underground bunkers complexes are expected to be available in the final weeks before the full release. The estimated final release of United Assault - Battle of the Bulge is 2-4 month into the future from early access launch. This all again depends on your feedback!

notes.title: Roadmap 2022 | Co-op , PvP and more!
notes.content:
Welcome to the Roadmap for 2022!
United Assault - Normandy '44 has come a long way and it's far from over! We are planning to release several major updates across the year. And here is how it's going to happen.

Battle of the Bulge
As announced last year, we'll developing a standalone expansion called Battle of the Bulge.
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1625340/United_Assault__Battle_of_the_Bulge/

This is with the port of Normandy '44 to Playstation 4 and 5 is currently the highest priority.
This means updates for Normandy '44 will slow down for a while. and will katch up again once we start adding in some of the new features and improvements from Battle of the Bulge.

Multiplayer
Yes, United Assault is getting a full multiplayer part, if you want to have it! For now, this will be for PC only and might come to consoles at a later point. The Multiplayer will be a standalone game which will be unlocked for free to owners of the base United Assault games (Normandy '44 or Battle of the Bulge) or will be made available as a seperate purchase.

This will ensure that the players are not split between several games and can play together as one big community.

This is the business model:
United Assault Multiplayer is a Buy-to-Play game without lootboxes or an ingame store. The Multiplayer in base contains the weapons and Maps of Normandy '44. By owning Battle of the Bulge, you will get the Battle of the Bulge map and weepons unlocked for free in the Multiplayer, if you don't own Battle of the Bulge, you can buy the gameworld and weapons as a DLC.

Co-op
the main focus of United Assault Multiplayer will be Co-op gameplay. The coop will use the full gameworld of Normandy '44 as a base with predefined Co-op Missions and randomly generated missions to choose. The Battle of the Bulge map will be made available at a later date for owners of Battle of the Bulge or the DLC owners.

PvP
We will also add a small PvP mode into the game which right now is Team Deathmatch only but more modes can be added during development. This mode will use parts of the gameworlds as PvP maps and is entirly unlocked. This means in PvP you don't need to buy anything additionally to get new maps and weapons.

Release
When it's done! We are targeting summer 2022 to unlock it to owners of Normandy '44 and Battle of the Bulge as a form of pre access. A real Early Access release might come in fall 2022, depending on feedback.

What do you think about this. Do you want Coop or just PvP or both? What are your toughts?

We’d love to keep you up-to-date! Please join us also on Discord or on Facebook

notes.title: The future of United Assault, Beyond Enemy Lines and survey evaluation
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

Today is the day we look into the future of United Assault, Beyond Enemy Lines and evaluate the latest 'Next Game' survey. There is a lot of new stuff coming in 2022 to play. Lets get started!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40088640/cba9debad65ec4df9b051aa8fc02b778a66f5dd1.png

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40088640/c5101b517df9d38ab2768fdeb42f05a1d48b1c11.png

United Assault - Normandy'44 is a massive success for Polygon Art and the quickest selling game we ever build! I have big planes for United assault and here is what's coming next:

I'm very Happy to announce:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40088640/2f3fc03bb5404f14332e455c98b4db2c0d5a595a.png
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1625340/United_Assault__Battle_of_the_Bulge/

https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/40088640/2e1034806bc63a5d27dcdf98b543c419a5f681d5.png
Click for full screen view

United Assault - Battle of the Bulge is a standalone expansion to United Assault - Normandy'44 and an open world rogue lite FPS set in 1944's depiction of Ardennes.

As a british paratromy you are assigned to a mission, few would qualify for. You are tasked to infiltrate enemy territory and locate, infiltrate and destroy one of germany's secret V2 factories in the Ardennes. You'll come along heavy enemy resistance, try to weaken their defense by destroying their tanks, equipment and by gathering secret documents.

[previewyoutube=S_a8nc8H4cY;full][/previewyoutube]

ADD UNITED ASSAULT - BATTLE OF THE BULGE TO YOUR WISHLIST!

What is new?

 Playing as a british paratrooper and deploying on a parachute into the game.
 Authentic british World War 2 weapons
 Larger and more detailed towns and cities
 Drivable vehicles scattered around the gameworld
 The story is now directly integrated into the main gamemode
 Procedural generated underground bunkers complexes (like dungeons)

What does this mean for United Assault - Normandy'44?
More updates, features and improvements! I'm not going to abandon United Assault - Normandy'44!
Both games are build with the same code base and allows me to patch new features and improvements from Battle of the Bulge back into Normandy '44. All gameplay, gunplay and AI improvements will find it's way into Normandy'44 as well as several new weapons! If you don't want Battle of the Bulge, you still benefit from its development and get regular news updates.

Looking even more into the future?
I plann to expand United Assault with 2 additional standalone expansions in the same form as Battle of the Bulge. Those are:

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40088640/ae32e4afe7704d986384170c41ebe27b778eea33.png

United Assault Social Media
Discord
Facebook
Twitter



{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40088640/cba9debad65ec4df9b051aa8fc02b778a66f5dd1.png



{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40088640/15b7e0fa8f8d38a78129449176be71e2e8553061.png

Beyond Enemy Lines is returning in 2022 with a major update to Beyond Enemy Lines 2 and an entirly new game!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40088640/584c45f38fd991d528811c488f36cc7c9fe7d853.png

Beyond Enemy Lines 2 is getting a free update to a Enhanced Edition!

This update will bring new content, improved game- and gunplay, enhanced visuals and major performance improvements. The before canceled DLC Beyond Enemy Lines 2 - Origins will be added for free to the game.

https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/40088640/a4ddd5b37e76e9f9e94ee85fe87e58beacd3412c.png
Click for full screen view

Features:

 A new, fully voiced 8 mission long campaign of the reimagined Beyond Enemy Lines 1 Story
 All other DLC contents will be free for all owners of the base game
 The price will increase from 24.99€ to 29.99€ to get in line with the Console versions
 Improved update pipeline for faster updates in the future
 Contails all map and mission improvements of the console version


The Beyond Enemy Lines 2 Enhanced Edition will be released early 2022 for free to all owners of the game on PC and Xbox One with additional native Xbox Series S|X support!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40088640/6966d5659cc0311781b25c7c344be9a592db23cf.png

Beyond Enemy Lines - Rising Dragon is the newest entry in the Beyond Enemy Lines franchise hitting Steam Early Access in Summer 2022!

Beyond Enemy Lines - Rising Dragon is a modern warfare shooter set in the Quang-Xiong Island, an autonomous island in the east chinese sea.
The island is of great military importance and the source of numerous conflicts. Whoever hasmilitary control over this territory, is in close range to attack china, taiwan, japan, as well as south and north korea.

Satellite intel reports a lot of recent activity on this island and satellite fotos indicate chinese forces occupied the island. China denies this information and confirms that it has not sent any troops to the region. We cannot verify the credibility of the statement, nor can we verify the identity of the occupiers.

We need to get to the bottom of this mess. You need to be careful - we don’t want a major international incident out of this.

Features:

 Powered by Unreal Engine 5 with Lumen Global Illumination and Reflections
 Command your own Squad
 Modern arsenal of highly detailed weapons
 Large, complex missions with full tactical freedom
 Mid mission checkpoints

Beyond Enemy Lines - Rising Dragon is smaller game in scope then Beyond Enemy Lines 2. We target a story set on 3-4 Missions, each lasting for ~60 minutes. We want to test out new stuff with this game, like a own AI controlled squad you can gve orders to and dip our toe into releasing a game with a new Engine - Unreal Engine 5. Beyond Enemy Lines - Rising Dragon is building the foundation for Beyond Enemy Lines 3 ...

The Next Game Survey
I asked on Social Media, Steam and other platforms what you want to see in the future. Here is the evaluation of this survey with 983 participants at the time of evaluation.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40088640/a55a14097947f434cbdb08bf9519e1938dcf885a.png{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40088640/3b9c88bc125a152404dd5c824fb9b1d5f9020c6b.png{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40088640/73241b9e800edc4dcc436a2e0d78879e236e4bea.png
Click for full screen view

The majority of you (60%) want to see a new Singleplayer game developed. The diversity in genres you want to see us develop was a majot supprise. FPS games are by far (35%) the most requested games, as we develop mostly FPS games this is no big surprise. Followed by this are Simulation (14%) and Role Playing (13%) and Third Person Shooter and Action Adventire (12%).

Beyond Enemy Lines - The Role Playing experience? How would this sound to you? We will continue to focus on FPS games but will definitly consider developing smaller games in the other genres in the future.

We also asked which game you would like to see next. 35% of you want to see a new franchise, 28% a new Beyond Enemy Lines and as United Assault is still a very fresh game it already gathered a respectful 23%.  As both Beyond Enemy Lines and United Assault got new content and games revealed in this news, let's jump to the new franchise ...

The new franchise

We asked for suggestions which game you would like to see. And apparently you have a very clear goal in mind for us. You want to see from us in the future:

A Singleplayer FPS with focus on Story, more linear gameplay with occasionally larger areas with more freedom. The games you mentioned where shocklingly simmilar.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40088640/a9576a3afae61bffbde29c63d3713909bed5b128.png
You frequently Menitioned Golden Eye and other 007 games as well as No One Lives Forever.

We will follow your wishes and start concepting a new James Bond/No One Lives Forever like franchise together with you in 2022. More on this will follow next year!

notes.title: Preview Build on Update v0.9.0 - Improved loading times
notes.content:
Soldiers,

a new peview build for the upcoming update 0.9.0 is now available!

This preview is soly focused on optimization and loading times. It does contain several smaller bug fixes and improvements but this is currently not the focus.

We know that loading times can sometimes be long in this game, even on older and slower hard drives. We took the time to modify the engine and implemented a new compression algorithm, which is as efficient as the old one, but a lot faster at decompressing data. We also modified the asynchronous level loading and asset organization.

This in total can improve loading times significantly and under the right condition can cut the loading times in half.

This is still very much experimental, so please report all issues you occur und did your loading times improve?

We’d love to keep you up-to-date! Please join us also on Discord or on Facebook

notes.title: Preview Build on Update v0.7.6
notes.content:
Soldiers,

on the road to Update 0.8.0 we have reached another checkpoint! The new preview update is adding the for now final weapon* Bazooka!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40088640/502747edcb0e43788a27a3eacee6c5c52eac8d56.jpg
The Bazooka can be unlocked at Rank 18 and can also be found in the final story mission.
You can carry up to 6 rockets for the Bazooka, 1 loaded and 5 in reserve. The rocket has a strongly curved trajectory and it needs 2 direct hit's to take out a mission objective from the distance and 3 direct hits to take out a Tank AI.

Due to it's strongly curved trajectory you can use the Bazooka also like a Mortar and kill targets far beyond your sightline across the entire map.

Please note that the weapon is not entirle animated right now, some animations are missing right now but will be added soon!

Native Linux Support
United Assault - Normandy '44 now has native Linux support in an early test phase!
We do not fully and officially support Linux right now, but we plan to do so after the release of v1.0.0.

This version is intended as a sneak peak and a tech test to gather feedback and informations. We currently just don't have the time and manpower to do a full QA run on it, however in our internal tests the linux build ran stable and without a crash.

The Linux version equals the currenlty new released v0.7.6 preview build and  can be accessed trough the preview build. Please report back how the game is running, does it crash or does other features not work?

notes.title: Preview on Update v0.7.0
notes.content:
Utilise the STG44, drive a Panzer III and complete the story campaign!

The upcoming update 0.7.0 supposed to be just maintenance update for some small updates while new content was to be added in update 0.8.0 - but we are now packing in everything!

Take a short look here:
[previewyoutube=8ZijhDHLc1g;full][/previewyoutube]
*We are aware of the animation and clipping issues with the shotgun, we are working on it!

Weapons
We are added several more new Weapons to United Assault, like the STG44 and the M1897 Shotgun.
The M1897 is unlockable only by completing the story campaign, the STG44 is unlocked at Rank 16. 

If you are lucky, you can find a drivable Panzer III in the now entirly unlocked open world.
There are some more weapons coming to the game but they won't be revealed now.

Story
The entire 4 mission long bonus campaign will be playable as a preview version. This means it's not 100% completed, voice overs are entirly missing in this versions and there are some refinements missing. We want to hear your feedback first before closing up the campaign.

Collectables
Scattered around the open world are several radio stations playing authentic music. Findd and collect them for a one time 250XP bonus for each track and the ability to play this track in the main menu background.

You are also able to decorate the freeroam bunker in the main menu. This is done by sacrificing earned XP. This will remove some hard earned XP and possible cost you an entire rank. But who don't want a tiger tank on the shelf?

notes.title: Update to v0.6.0 & Looking into the future
notes.content:
Update Notes

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40088640/bb0c58ea95df6cd9d5e7ab97ce95b9ea97519cb3.jpg
Mount the MG42 and defend your position!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40088640/fb8cf3b6aa2db4378996c060cce862b06a2e3120.png

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40088640/3942565b9143b207e7d6fcadeff5a0bfbb18bfa5.jpg

What's up for the future?
We are now midway through the early access phase and it was a great success until now and hopefully in the future! You are an amazing community, the talks, the feedback and ideas and passion you put into this game is astonishing!

Whats coming in the short run?

AI
We hear your voices and feedback clearly. With the new update v0.6.0 we added parts which where initially planned for update 0.7.0. By doing this we opened the possibility to focus more on the AI for the next update. But (yeah there needs to be an unfortunate but) ween need to keep your expecations grounded. We will work on the AI, the balancing, timings and other improvements like animations. But please don't expect the AI to become a genius with update 0.7.0. Due to the extremly random nature of this game and the sheer number of AI (rougly 1000 soldiers are constantly simulated) we have limitations and hard constraints. We try to do our best to squeeze more out of it and get the AI more natural.

Weapons
We'll begin adding new weapons in the next updates again and raise the level cap. Grenades are also planned to be added soon!

Campaign
The Campaign will be made available in the last update before the game leaves Early Access. We are starting voice recordings for the campaign next week!

Whats coming in the long run?
We are committing ourself to United Assault! We will release a standalone expension later this year (again as an Early Access release). And before you type in anger 'This game isn't even finished - focus on this one instead', keep calm and continue reading!

The expansion is not in full development right now. This will start once United Assault exits Early Access! We know what we want to do and a few assets have been created to block out the very rough layout of the new map. This expansion will be build on top of the existing United Assault - Normandy '44. This means feature improvements made with the expansion will be made available for free in the base game via patch. Selected new weapons of the expansion will find their way into the base game.

This means, more content for you for free!

notes.title: Preview on Update v0.4.0
notes.content:
The Springfield, 1911, Rank 14 and Liesville-sur-Douve are coming with update 0.4.0!

Update 0.4.0 will be the largest update for United Assault - Normandy '44 so far. But what's included?
New Weapons! The Springfield sniper rifle will be added with a realistic working scope and the M1911 will be the new default pistol! The Springfield will be unlocked at the new maximum Rank of 14.

Take a look here:
[previewyoutube=agKzvJa5aAU;full][/previewyoutube]

A night version of the map will be available with the next update as well as the new tutorial and  audio settings. The AI once again got an update to further improve their reactions and responsiveness.

Also new, a slide function will be added to the movement modes. If you are sprinting, press crouch to slide. This however does only work if you have at least 20% stammina remaining and each slide will cost 20% stammina. While sliding your weapons are extremly inaccurate and shooting while sliding is only a last resort option. This is an experimental feature, if most of you dislike it, it will be changed or removed.

Take a look at sliding the the video above (captured before the 20% stammina cost was added).

Another experimental feature and from version 0.4.0 by default enabled: difficulty scaling.
While ranking up and unlocking new weapons, the game might become to easy for you. With this difficulty scaling the AI deals more damage the higher your rank. At the new max Rank 14, you will only survive a very few hits - you need to be extra carefully!

If you don't like it more difficult, turn it off!

notes.title: FAQ
notes.content:
FAQ - Frequently Asked Questions

1) Will the Gameworld get expanded?
Yes! We try to add at least one new location with each major update!

2) Will there be new Weapons?
Yes! Some of them are already listed on the Roadmap and some will remain a secret until they are available.

3) How often will the game be updated?
We try to update the game at least once a week. But as Game Development is not 100% predictable and some bug can be nasty to track down, it might stretch sometimes a bit further.

3) Will the game be released on other Systems?
Yes! The game is coming to Xbox, Nintendo Switch and Playstation later this year!

4) What should I expect from this game at Early Access start?
Expect a Alpha version. No Marketing Alpha, a real Alpha! The gameworld in incomplete, some sounds and textures are missing and some features (like the UI/Menu) are incomplete. It is playable, you can unlock new Weapons and play the game in a compressed version. Expect Bugs, crashes and glitches. That's why it's launched in Early Access. Report your ideas and feedback and we will try to adress them!

5) Is the passive Multiplayer available at launch?
Yes and No. The game can and will establish a connection to the server and will send required informations. However the Server does currently only store the data to build up a database but not send back any data. This will be enabled in a later update.

6) Does the passive multiplayer collect personal data?
No! It just shares informations of Gameplay statistics, Kills, Headshots, Objectives completed and so on. Other then gameplay related data,nothing is transferred.

7) Do I need an additional account for Passive Multiplayer?
No! You only need to have Steam running in the background and that's it!

Do you have another question? Let us know!
